title: Tenable is up double digits with no company news. Is the wholecybersecurity bounce just a bet on Palo Alto tonight?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
\[TENB\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TENB/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TENB/)) jumped 11.37% in the midday  
write-up, to $42.99 from Tuesday's close of $38.60, after premarket  
had been roughly flat. Later prints were even stronger, around +16%.  
There was no Tenable-specific news or filing.  
  
The catalyst was sector-wide: cybersecurity software bounced after a  
month-long rout, with Morgan Stanley turning more constructive on the  
group, citing healthy demand checks and compressed valuations.  
\[OKTA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/OKTA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/OKTA/)),  
\[CRWD\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRWD/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRWD/)) and  
\[PANW\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/PANW/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/PANW/)) ran too, and Palo Alto  
reports after the close.  
  
The write-up on today's \[TENB\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TENB/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TENB/)) move  
and the sector bounce, with no company-specific headline:  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tenable-holdings-tenb-stock-up-11-61-today-40391/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tenable-holdings-tenb-stock-up-11-61-today-40391/)  
  
If this is just positioning into  
\[PANW\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/PANW/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/PANW/)) earnings, does a name like  
Tenable still hold the gain after the print?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's midday write-up, not a  
live quote, and the gain has already widened.
